body: I glance at my name on the volunteer list in disbelief, feeling an intense wave of anger building within me. My pulse quickens as I realize this isn't just a mistake—this was something I willingly agreed to. The thought of confrontation fills me with dread but also ignites a spark of determination to understand why they chose me for this role.
